budget_items.topic: Insurance: Police/Fire injured on duty (IOD) bid for FY18
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported that going out to bid for IOD insurance for FY18 produced savings of about $7K.
budget_items.quote: went out to bid for police/fire injured on duty (iod) insurance for fy18. savings of about $7k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Accountant said the Town is still waiting for a $119K 40S reimbursement for FY17 from the State; the DOR has not responded; it will be posted as revenue if received and has no effect on FY18.
budget_items.quote: still waiting for the 40s reimbursement of $119k for fy17 from the state, karen

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of whether Sewer and Water enterprise fund debt is part of the debt policy limits; the Town would be financially responsible if those departments fail to cover their debt; the Town Manager recommended explicit language excluding enterprise funds from the debt limits.
budget_items.quote: should the sewer or water dept. fail to cover their debt, the town would be financial responsible.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chief is soliciting bids to rebuild the pump on Truck 4; a question was asked whether spending funds on the rebuild would extend the truck's life. No amount was printed.
budget_items.quote: the chief is soliciting bids to rebuild the pump on truck 4. question was asked if funds are expended to rebuild the pump, would this extend the life of the truck?

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A monthly invoice of S347K is being approved outside of a meeting; the minutes say the Board of Selectmen (BOS) voted not to sign the warrant for it and asked for an explanation.
budget_items.quote: this month invoice is s347k and is being approved outside of a meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $9600 bill for stabilizers for the projectors was questioned by the BOS; the School Building Committee approved the bill; the BOS felt it should be the responsibility of the vendor or contractor.
budget_items.quote: a $9600 bill for stabilizers for the projectors was question by the bos.

budget_items.topic: Pavement Management Plan funding from excise tax
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The additional $50K a year from excise tax is to go into the PMP budget for road maintenance alongside Chapter 90 funds; $50K for 10 years adds $500K to the plan, plus an additional $250K the Town adds.
budget_items.quote: $50k for 10 years adds an additional $500k to the plan. plus the additional $250k the town adds
